classification.difficultyReason: Recognise alternate angles between the parallel lines, then apply sin⁻¹ in the right triangle.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of $\theta$ in this diagram. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
The two horizontal lines are parallel, so $\theta$ equals the angle at the bottom of the sloping line (alternate angles). In the right-angled triangle, opposite $=6$ and hypotenuse $=10$. Use sine.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{O}{H}\\\sin\theta&=\frac{6}{10}\\\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{6}{10}\right)\\\theta&\approx36.9^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
